name: webmacro
description: Load DuckDB macros (scalar or table) from any URL — gists, pastebins, your team's macro library. Share reusable SQL by URL the same way you share scripts.

cta.title: Macros from a URL
cta.description: Install WebMacro to fetch and register DuckDB macros from any HTTPS URL — share reusable SQL building blocks with a one-line load.
